messages:
Ellen (docs): Heads up: I ran into two copy-paste issues in the API reference today. The /responses example mixes discriminator keys (\"kind\" vs \"variant\") and our generated SDK picks the wrong union branch. Also the curl file-upload snippet omits an explicit boundary and fails when pasted into bash.

Marco (eng-runtime): Oof. Do you have the exact lines?

Ellen (docs): Yup: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/blob/main/openapi/responses.yaml#L120-L148 and the curl in docs/upload.md. Quick repro attached to the issue.

Nia (sdk): Our generator expects a discriminator named \"variant\". If examples use other keys it flattens the oneOf. Best path: update examples to include \"variant\". Minimal and low-risk.

Ellen (docs): Proposed example tweak for chat branch: { \"variant\": \"chat\", \"messages\": [{\"role\":\"assistant\",\"content\":\"Hello\"}] } -- I'll add that to the YAML and change other examples to match.

Marco (eng-runtime): Sounds good. I can open a tiny PR to update the docs and add a migration note saying examples now include a discriminator property so SDKs generate correctly. No runtime changes.

Nia (sdk): Also please add a Node FormData snippet for the upload to keep snippets consistent with SDK examples. Something like: const f = new FormData(); f.append('file', fs.createReadStream('a.txt')); await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: f, headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${K}` } });

Ellen (docs): For the curl snippet I'll add an explicit boundary and full --data-binary block so copy/paste works in single-shot: curl -X POST ... -H \"Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----BoundaryXYZ\" --data-binary $'------BoundaryXYZ\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"a.txt\"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nhi\r\n------BoundaryXYZ--'

ci-bot: PR #4801 opened by marco: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4801 - updates response examples to include \"variant\", fixes upload curl example, adds Node FormData snippet and a note in docs/migration.md. CI: docs-lint OK, sample-tests OK.

Ravi (pm): Confirming this is docs-only, right? No API contract changes?

Marco (eng-runtime): Correct. Docs-only. Merged to main in PR #4801 (commit 9f8d7c). Deployed to staging docs.redwood-inference.dev.

Ellen (docs): I'll sanity-check staging and close the issue once verified. Thanks y'all :raised_hands:
